thin_dimensions.reason: Four items establish the construct, but selector behavior must show whether this family is sufficiently distinct from environment preference and governed drains.
Four items are intentionally cautious because rigid independence/sociality claims are not governed color doctrine.
Four items provide initial coverage; Blue and Yellow triggers remain partly OWNER-governed research hypotheses.

owner_governance_required.claim: Blue trust grows through open, authentic, possibility-rich interaction.
Color-specific time horizons generalize beyond the governed motives expressed in each item.
Green seeks causal repeatability after success as a general reward.
Interpersonal completion signals generalize beyond the stated conversation context.
